inputs.original_text: So this whole Liberal split is nothing but elite theater to lock down the real issues. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the party to be open-minded about raising taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, but the surface claim of some philosophy clash with the opposition leader is just cover to protect the big interests that profit from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites making sure the narrative stays controlled and no real pressure builds.
inputs.modified_text: This whole Liberal split is nothing but a staged distraction from the elites to bury what really matters. Angus Taylor has clearly moved to shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for even considering higher taxes on gas companies and rolling back those concessions for property investors. They want everyone to swallow the line that it's some philosophy clash with the opposition leader, but that's just the cover to shield the big interests raking in the profits from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites coordinating to keep the narrative locked down and prevent any real pressure from building.
